answer:
The newest release notes I have for Muse Glimmer are v0.32.8, and they say it runs on all platforms: "Muse Glimmer is now available on all platforms." [ollama/v0.32.8.md]

The same release lists the added platform support: "Add Muse Glimmer support for NVIDIA, AMD, and additional platforms" [ollama/v0.32.8.md]

This follows v0.32.7, which only had initial support through the MLX engine on Apple Silicon: "Muse Glimmer is currently available via initial support via Ollama's MLX engine on Apple Silicon." [ollama/v0.32.7.md]

The retrieved context has no notes for v0.32.9 through v0.32.15, so I can't say whether those releases changed platform support. v0.32.8 is the latest I can confirm.
